description:
**Phase A — Foundation. Deps: none.**

Define entry structs mirroring `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts` byte-for-byte:
- `Header`, `MessageEntry`, `CompactionEntry`, `BranchSummaryEntry`, `ThinkingLevelChangeEntry`, `ModelChangeEntry`, `LabelEntry`, `CustomEntry`
- Passthrough struct for unknown `type` values (forward-compat).

Field shapes (camelCase preserved on the wire):
- `CompactionEntry`: `type "compaction" | id | parentId | timestamp | summary | firstKeptEntryId | tokensBefore | fromHook? | details?`
- `BranchSummaryEntry`: `type "branch_summary" | id | parentId | timestamp | summary | fromId | fromHook? | details?`

Tests: encode/decode round-trip via Jason; field naming preserves camelCase.
title: A1. SessionEntry typed union (types only)
